items.title: James Lincoln Collier interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: I was reading Rebelais when I was in high school

ctx.x: Instead of watching. So by the time — I was reading adult books by the time I was nine simply because they’d be lying there somewhere and I’d pick it up and start reading it. I was reading Rebelais when I was in high school, I was reading Dickens when I was in high school, just because the sets of the stuff were there. You wanted something to read, oh I think I’ll read Oliver Twist.
It must have prepared you pretty well for college studies?
